subject: Warm signup — a few quick fit questions before we lock a demo slot
messages: From: Ava Chen To: Sofia Garcia Cc: Ben Carter Date: 2026-05-14T09:12:00-07:00 Subject: Quick fit questions after your self-signup Hi Sofia — thanks for signing up and trying Redwood! I pulled your account and saw some early activity — would love to do a brief call to make sure a demo is a fit and to surface the right pilot advice. Before we schedule, two quick areas to help us tailor the session: 1) Primary use case: what are you most looking to build? (examples: live customer support summarization, search/embeddings, content generation for marketing, internal knowledge base) 2) Traffic: rough QPS or daily requests today and target after 3 months (ballpark is fine) 3) Timeline & priority: are you looking for a pilot in 2 weeks / 1 month / 2+ months? If you can send 2–3 short bullets on those, I’ll propose three demo slots that work for our CS/solutions folks. I can also include Ben (SDR) or Monica (Customer Success) depending on who you want on the call. Example slots (PT): Tue 5/18 10:00–10:30, Wed 5/19 14:00–14:30, Thu 5/20 09:00–09:30 — happy to adjust to your timezone. Thanks — Ava Ava Chen Account Executive, Redwood Inference redwood.com Attachments: none in this message From: Sofia Garcia To: Ava Chen Date: 2026-05-14T10:03:00-07:00 Subject: Re: Quick fit questions after your self-signup Hi Ava — thanks for reaching out. Happy to answer quickly: 1) Use case: customer support triage + short-response generation and root-cause extraction. We want to triage incoming tickets and produce short summaries to push to agents and also generate suggested replies for first-touch. 2) Traffic: currently ~40k incoming messages/month (~1.3k/day) but we expect to ramp quickly once we integrate. Goal is ~120k/day within 3 months for peak season (we know this is aggressive; looking for guidance on batching and cost options). 3) Timeline: we’d like a pilot in ~4 weeks if possible (team bandwidth is limited in the next 2 weeks). Preferences / notes: we are fine starting on hosted, but we’ll likely need a dedicated/private option later due to data retention policies. Our team is PST (based in San Diego). Please include any pre-demo info we should prepare. —Sofia Sofia Garcia Head of AI, LeanRetail sofia@leanretail.io From: Ava Chen To: Sofia Garcia Cc: Ben Carter Date: 2026-05-14T10:28:00-07:00 Subject: Re: Quick fit questions after your self-signup Thanks Sofia — super helpful. Based on that traffic profile and timeline we’ll route you to our solutions CS to make the pilot concrete (Monica handles pilot scoping; copying her on the next message). A few quick notes: - For 120k/day you’ll want to consider prefix caching and batching; we’ll share a cost/throughput sketch on the call. - Hosted is fine to start; Dedicated/Private is an option when you need retention/isolated capacity. Can you confirm whether your data retention requirements are strict (e.g., prohibit persistence outside your VPC) or flexible for the pilot? Also, can you attach any traffic estimate or representative sample (CSV/Excel) — that helps our sizing. I’m attaching a short traffic template (traffic_estimates.xlsx) you can fill; if you prefer a call first we can lock a slot. Proposed slots (PT) — pick one, or tell me a time that works for you: • Tue 5/18 10:00–10:30 PT • Wed 5/19 14:00–14:30 PT • Thu 5/20 09:00–09:30 PT If none of those work, I can propose morning windows next week. Once you pick, I’ll send a calendar invite and include Monica for pilot scoping. Best, Ava Account Executive, Redwood Inference Attachments: traffic_estimates.xlsx (spreadsheet) From: Sofia Garcia To: Ava Chen Cc: Ben Carter Date: 2026-05-18T08:17:00-07:00 Subject: Re: Quick fit questions after your self-signup Hi Ava — thanks, I filled out the traffic template and attached it. Quick update: the 5/18 slot conflicts with an internal planning meeting; would you be able to move to Wed 5/19 15:00 PT instead? Also please include Monica Patel (I’ll loop her) — she’s leading pilots on our side and will want to drive the technical checklist. Also, we will want to discuss SSO/SCIM and logging/audit retention — happy to cover that on the same call. Attaching: traffic_estimates.xlsx —Sofia From: Monica Patel To: Sofia Garcia , Ava Chen Cc: Ben Carter Date: 2026-05-18T15:04:00-07:00 Subject: Re: Quick fit questions after your self-signup — agenda + pre-demo checklist Hi Sofia / Ava — thanks for the note and for filling the template. I’m Monica (CS Solutions) and I’ll be on the pilot call. Confirming Wed 5/19 15:00–15:30 PT works for our team; I’ll send a calendar invite in a follow-up. Quick proposed agenda (15–30 min): 1) 5 min — goals & success criteria for pilot (Sofia) 2) 10–15 min — traffic, architecture, and data flow (we’ll review sample rows from your template) 3) 5–10 min — pilot plan & next steps (environments, SSO, logging, handoff to SRE) Pre-demo ask: can you upload a small representative sample of raw tickets (CSV, 100–200 rows, remove any PII) and paste a short note on retention needs. I added a short checklist doc here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3Example-pre-demo — please drop the files there before the call. I’ve also attached a one-page pre-demo checklist (pre-demo-checklist.pdf). Looking forward — Monica Monica Patel Customer Success, Redwood Inference Attachments: pre-demo-checklist.pdf
